product.how_it_works: RF-DETR is the fixed person-detection gate. Cosmos analyzes people and helmets, publishes confirmed goal findings, and writes Markdown into MN memory for questions and summaries. Per-stage benchmarks expose timing, failures and skipped coverage.

overview: Watches your monitoring goal and reports verified events with times and frames. Ask questions about retained sampled footage or request a video summary. Start with the warehouse demo or connect an approved camera stream. Requires an NVIDIA GPU.
